record.notes: Value is the room-temperature conductivity quoted from the original source article for inorganic SE case I7, as analysed by the authors; the paper argues it is a unit-label inconsistency (the source plotted sigma*T in S m-1, so 0.854 S m-1 = 8.54e-3 S cm-1 is the intended value). The composition and mobile ion are not stated in the text (the source database is described as lithium-ion-conductor data, but I7 is not explicitly identified as Li). The unit S cm–1 is split by PDF line numbering in the source; the quote is truncated before the unit. Gel polymer electrolyte values (e.g., 7.2×10–4 S cm–1 for G5) were omitted because they are not solid Li/Na-ion conductors of a named material.
